remaining_limits: Whole operand masking does not preserve expressions or cross-rung reference identity.
Semantic coherence, Studio import, execution timing and behavior remain unvalidated.
Local XML variants do not encode complete subtrees or all rung patterns; mandated coverage is retained, not every combination.
Two output writes are individually atomic, not a bundle transaction. A second-write failure must be detected by comparing the XML hash with the report.
Original-source regeneration and inspection of that new public result remain user-run steps.
